properties.title: ARLO BY DEVTRACO

Anchored in the prestigious and serene suburb of Cantonments, ARLO is a curated collection of residences ranging from studios to three-bedroom penthouses; each designed with the modern investor and luxury lifestyle buyer in mind. Every line, every finish, every square metre is deliberate. Offering a balance of form, function, and elevated experiences.

Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows flood each residence with natural light, creating an ever-changing interplay of sun and shadow.

Each residence is designed to feel open, serene, and effortlessly connected to its surroundings. Light becomes a living element—shifting with the day, enhancing the mood, and softening every corner.

Carefully layered ambient lighting adds depth and warmth, creating a sense of calm that lingers from morning to night.


Arlo is an income-generating asset designed for effortless ownership. At Arlo, your apartment is more than a living space—it’s a smart investment. An experienced management partner takes care of everything on your behalf: from marketing and tenant screening to maintenance, guest services, and detailed reporting. With rising demand for short- and mid-term stays from business travelers, expats, and tourists, Arlo offers high occupancy potential and consistent rental income all without lifting a finger.

Rich textures and tones define the interiors—warm woods, soft matte finishes, and understated detailing come together to create spaces that feel both timeless and tactile.

The kitchens are refined and efficient, blending elegance with intuitive design.

Bathrooms are equally considered, fitted with sleek fixtures that speak to subtle luxury and enduring quality. Nothing is Random!

Arlo isn’t about excess, it’s about precision, breathtaking architecture, indulgent interiors, smart layouts, thoughtful amenities, and premium finishes that speak quietly but confidently. Anchored in the prestigious and serene suburb of Cantonments, ARLO is a curated collection of residences ranging from studios to three-bedroom penthouses; each designed with the modern investor in mind. Every layout, finish, window placement and square meter is deliberate coming together to create a space
that feels inspiring, seamless and balanced.

With unit types in high demand and its prime location, ARLO offers a highly efficient vehicle for capital growth and rental income. Whether you’re looking for a place to call home, a pied-à-terre or you are looking to expand your portfolio, ARLO meets you at the peak of lifestyle fulfillment and investment power.

There are a few locations in Accra that embody prestige, privacy, and security quite like Cantonments. Lined with embassies, tree-shaded streets, security services and some of the city's most refined restaurants, this location provides a calm atmosphere that is hard to replicate yet remains deeply connected to the pulse of the capital.

From ARLO, you’re just minutes from Beautiful Beaches, Kotoka International Airport and Airport City’s business district. Osu and Labone, Accra’s social and cultural hotspots are also just minutes away from your new home. Housing diplomats, executives, and global citizens, Cantonments makes every investment a confident move. 

At ARLO, life unfolds beautifully. From peaceful mornings on your private balcony to curated social events, every detail is designed foryour comfort and ease. With wellness-focused amenities, modern conveniences, and spaces for connection, daily living feels luxurious. Whether it’s a quiet night in,
rooftop hosting, or exploring vibrant Cantonments, ARLO moves to your rhythm.

properties.title: REGALIA BY IMAANI
properties.description:
Private Courtyard Address.


Regalia is a composed residential development at Airport on the prestigious Patrice Lumumba Street. 
Centered around a private landscaped courtyard from spacious studios to expansive penthouses, each residence reflects intelligent planning and refined detail.

Regalia is not a tower reaching for attention. It is a composed, mid-rise residence — seven stories of precision-crafted living arranged around a private landscaped courtyard.

Every design decision serves a purpose: natural ventilation paths reduce mechanical cooling, recessed balconies create shade and privacy, and floor-to-ceiling glazing invites the garden inward.

From the lobby to the rooftop, every surface has been considered. Porcelain floor tiles, engineered stone countertops, solid timber joinery, and brushed metal fixtures combine to create spaces that feel permanent and considered.

Two levels of dedicated basement parking provide secure, covered spaces for every unit. The building infrastructure includes backup power systems, dedicated water storage, pre-installed high-speed fibre connections, and EV-charging provisions.

blogPosts.title: GHANA REAL ESTATE MARKET TRENDS 2026 | EXPERT INSIGHTS FROM HEIST BROKERAGE & CONSTRUCTION
blogPosts.excerpt: Explore the latest Ghana real estate market trends in 2026. Learn about investment opportunities, buyer behavior, sustainability, property demand and expert insights from Heist Brokerage & Construction.
blogPosts.coverAlt: Cover image for Heist Brokerage & Construction’s 2026 Ghana Real Estate Market Trends report, featuring a modern Accra skyline, luxury residential developments, and key insights on property investment, market growth, sustainability, and transparency.”
blogPosts.body:
Ghana’s Real Estate Market in 2026: A Market That’s Growing Smarter, Not Just Bigger

Published by Heist Brokerage & Construction

There is a saying in real estate that “markets don’t change overnight—they evolve.” Looking at Ghana’s property sector in 2026, that couldn’t be more accurate.

For the past few years, the conversation around real estate has largely revolved around rising construction costs, inflation and affordability. While those issues haven’t disappeared completely, this year feels different. Confidence is gradually returning, buyers are becoming more informed, and developers are shifting their focus from simply building more homes to building better communities.

At Heist Brokerage & Construction, we believe understanding the market is just as important as investing in it. Here’s what we’re seeing across Ghana’s real estate landscape in 2026.



STABILITY IS RETURNING TO THE MARKET

One of the biggest changes this year isn’t visible in the buildings—it’s happening in the economy.

With inflation easing compared to previous years, the Ghana Cedi showing greater stability, and financing conditions gradually improving, investors are beginning to regain confidence. Developers who delayed projects during periods of economic uncertainty are returning to the market, while buyers who had adopted a “wait and see” approach are becoming more willing to make long-term decisions.  

Although financing remains a challenge for many households, the overall environment is considerably healthier than it was just a few years ago.



BUYERS ARE LOOKING BEYOND LUXURY

For years, luxury apartments dominated conversations about Ghanaian real estate. Today, however, demand is shifting.

The strongest interest is coming from middle-income professionals, young families and entrepreneurs searching for homes that balance affordability with quality.

People are asking practical questions:

Is the location accessible?
Is the land documentation reliable?
Are there schools and hospitals nearby?
Will this property appreciate over time?
Can I comfortably maintain it?

These questions are changing the way developers design projects, placing greater emphasis on functionality rather than unnecessary extravagance.



CLEAN DOCUMENTATION IS BECOMING A COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGE

Perhaps the biggest lesson buyers have learned over the past decade is that location alone isn’t enough.

In 2026, property buyers are placing far greater value on properly documented land, transparent transactions and reputable developers.

The market is rewarding companies that prioritise due diligence, professional project management and honest communication.

Trust is no longer a marketing slogan—it has become a genuine competitive advantage.



SECONDARY LOCATIONS ARE ATTRACTING SERIOUS ATTENTION

While Accra remains Ghana’s busiest property market, surrounding communities are becoming increasingly attractive.

Areas experiencing infrastructure improvements and expanding road networks are seeing growing demand from buyers who want more space without paying premium city-centre prices.

Investors are also recognising that long-term returns often come from identifying tomorrow’s growth areas rather than competing for yesterday’s hotspots.  



SUSTAINABILITY IS MOVING INTO THE MAINSTREAM

Not long ago, environmentally conscious housing was considered a luxury.

Today, buyers are paying closer attention to energy efficiency, water conservation and building materials that reduce long-term maintenance costs.

Features such as:

Solar-ready electrical systems
Rainwater harvesting
Natural ventilation
Energy-efficient lighting
Smart home technology

are becoming increasingly desirable—not because they are fashionable, but because they reduce the cost of ownership over time.



OFF-PLAN SALES CONTINUE TO GROW

Off-plan purchasing remains one of the most attractive ways to enter Ghana’s property market.

With phased payment structures and lower entry prices, many buyers are choosing to secure properties before construction is completed.

However, the market has also become more cautious.

Buyers now want clear construction timelines, transparent payment schedules and regular project updates before committing their money.

Developers who consistently deliver on their promises are earning stronger reputations than ever before.



THE DIASPORA REMAINS A POWERFUL DRIVER

Ghanaians living abroad continue to play a significant role in the country’s property market.

Whether purchasing family homes, retirement properties or investment apartments, diaspora buyers remain an important source of demand.

What has changed is that overseas investors now expect greater transparency, digital communication and professional after-sales service.

Virtual property tours, online documentation and secure payment processes have become standard expectations rather than optional extras.  



LOOKING AHEAD

The Ghanaian property market isn’t experiencing explosive growth.

Instead, it is becoming more disciplined, more transparent and more sustainable.

This is healthy.

Markets built on solid fundamentals tend to outperform markets driven purely by speculation.

For investors, homeowners and developers alike, 2026 presents opportunities—but success will increasingly depend on careful planning, informed decisions and working with professionals who understand both the opportunities and the responsibilities that come with real estate.



OUR PERSPECTIVE

At Heist Brokerage & Construction, we see real estate as more than buying land or constructing buildings.

It is about creating lasting value.

Every property tells a story. Every development shapes a community. Every investment has the potential to create wealth for generations when built on integrity, professionalism and thoughtful planning.

As Ghana’s real estate market continues to mature, we remain committed to helping our clients make informed decisions with confidence.

Because great investments aren’t built on hype.

They’re built on trust.
